Smart Phone Detection Gate FC-H (29-inch Display)

Display: LG 29-inch (Dual-sided)
External Dimensions: ≤ 2430(H) x 1015(W) x 650(D) mm
Advanced phone detection for schools and high-security sites; identifies devices even when powered off or disassembled; 29-inch large-screen display for clear tracking; excludes daily metal items (belts, keys) via AI algorithm.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC-H Smart Phone Detection Gate utilizes cutting-edge electromagnetic wave signal detection technology to accurately identify mobile phones in any state, including power-on, power-off, or when the battery and SIM card are removed. This device features a powerful intelligent filtering algorithm that effectively excludes common daily items such as belt buckles, glasses, keys, pens, and stationery boxes, allowing it to focus specifically on detecting electronic products like tablets, laptops, iPads, and digital cameras. Even if a phone is wrapped in five layers of copper foil, the gate reliably triggers audio-visual alarms and pinpoints the exact location of the threat. Equipped with a massive 29-inch dual-sided LCD screen, it offers superior management efficiency and a striking visual impact for schools, secure facilities, and high-end security environments.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • 29-inch large display for clear, real-time zone-mapping visualization of detected devices.
  • Daily Item Filtering: Excludes belt buckles, glasses, pens, pencil cases and other everyday items during phone detection.
  • Zone Display: 6 independent detection zones with accurate per-zone suspicious item display.
  • People Counting: Automatic real-time display of passage count and alarm count on the main interface.
  • Four-Side LED Positioning: LED indicators on all four sides display the prohibited item location with 360° visibility.
  • Audio-Visual Alarm: Voice alarm and LED strip flash alarm functions.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Detection Zones12 independent zones (6 on each side) for precise vertical localization
Main DisplayLG 29-inch dual-front/back widescreen LCD
